_doc: Golden runs of the `atlas` CLI (crates/atlas-cli/tests/golden.rs). They were recorded from the TypeScript CLI (packages/cli, retired once the Rust CLI reproduced every run byte for byte), so they pin the output contract integrations rely on; the journal and vault scenarios were recorded from the Rust CLI. Each scenario runs its steps against a fresh fake server (for a token for its `token_apps`, todo when absent, on a current server offering `server_apps`, todo and journal when absent; `token_write: false` makes the token read-only and `token_expires_at` is its expiry) with the clock fixed at `now` and ATLAS_TZ `tz`. A `seed` step writes an entity's fields from another device of the account and names it `ref`; a `revoke` step revokes the token; an `expire` step makes it expire. A run step passes `argv` ({name} is a ref or a value captured earlier: `capture` maps a name to a field of the step's JSON output) optional `env` overrides and `stdin` (what `--json -` reads), and expects `exit`, `stdout` (the text printed, "<usage>" for the help text) and `stderr` (the lines printed). In outputs every UUID is replaced by <id:N>, numbered by first appearance in the scenario. A deliberate change to the output is recorded with GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 cargo nextest run -p atlas-cli golden.
